specific_scope_checks: The sheaf guides retain ModuleData.nonneg; generic Hilbert-module results are described separately.
The realization guides identify the finite-generator setting and extension by the dual of the radical.
The image-comparison guides retain the upper-kernel freeness hypothesis for the global inclusion.
The character guides use the actual sheaf characters, with canonical KL identification in its later polynomial step.
The local-intersection guide retains the nonzero-diagonal hypothesis.
The main-theorem route includes the geometric path identity, conditional schedule comparison, exact endpoint implication and reverse projectivity before the simultaneous induction.
The finite dihedral reflection parameters use odd residues modulo twice the maximum intrinsic length; the two-reflection plane statement retains distinctness.
